tickerText: WELCOME TO RAW TALENT, WHERE CHILDCARE STAFFING MEETS FREEDOM, FLEXIBILITY AND OPPORTUNITY! WE'RE TRANSFORMING THE WAY AUSTRALIAN CHILDCARE CENTRES CONNECT WITH QUALIFIED, RELIABLE EDUCATORS. FOR CENTRES, THAT MEANS FILLING SHIFTS IN SECONDS, REDUCING AGENCY COSTS AND BUILDING A TRUSTED TEAM OF FAMILIAR FACES. FOR EDUCATORS, IT MEANS TAKING CONTROL OF YOUR CAREER, CHOOSING WHEN AND WHERE YOU WORK, ENJOYING COMPETITIVE PAY AND GETTING PAID WEEKLY! WITH MORE THAN 1,600 CHILDCARE CENTRES, OVER 6,000 EDUCATORS AND 100,000 SHIFTS FILLED, RAW TALENT IS HELPING MAKE STAFFING SIMPLER ACROSS AUSTRALIA. OUR EASY-TO-USE APP CONNECTS THE RIGHT PEOPLE WITH THE RIGHT OPPORTUNITIES, WITHOUT THE TRADITIONAL AGENCY HASSLE. WHETHER YOU'RE MANAGING A BUSY CHILDCARE CENTRE OR LOOKING FOR YOUR NEXT GREAT SHIFT, WE'RE HERE TO HELP YOU SUCCEED. LESS STRESS, MORE CHOICE, BETTER CONNECTIONS AND REAL OPPORTUNITIES. BE YOUR OWN BOSS. BUILD YOUR IDEAL TEAM. DISCOVER A SMARTER WAY TO WORK WITH RAW TALENT. VISIT RAWTALENT.COM.AU AND GET STARTED TODAY!
